name: Ama (Shimane, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ama town emblem in green: a disc of stylised waves and curled strokes with a white centre.
history: Municipal flag of Ama, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted in 1970; the emblem dates from 8 July 1915.

features.role: Ama town emblem — a disc of stylised waves and curled strokes with a white centre
